response.sql: WITH per_op AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans GROUP BY crewref HAVING AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM per_op) SELECT AVG(p.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(p.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(p.avg_gb_per_min - o.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM per_op p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_gb_per_min > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: Per-scan GB/minute is gbsize/spanmin; rows with NULL gbsize or NULL/zero spanmin are skipped for the rate (zero spanmin treated as missing to avoid division by zero). Total scans sums scancount over all of the operator's records, ignoring NULLs.

The all-operator average is the simple (unweighted) mean of the per-operator average rates, as the request says 'simple average across all operators'. Operators with no computable rate are excluded from that mean.
